references.text: Regulations stating that the sin offering is to be eaten by the priests in a holy place, and that all male priests may eat of it.
The priest who presents the sin offering shall eat it in a holy place, in the court of the tent of meeting.
All male priests may eat of the guilt offering; it shall be eaten in a holy place, for it is most holy.
Moses instructs Aaron and his sons to eat the grain offering at the altar, in a holy place, because it is most holy.
Moses asks why the sin offering was not eaten in the holy place, since it is most holy.
The bread of the Presence belongs to Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place, for it is most holy.
The preceding verse describing what belongs to the priests from the most holy offerings.
